what: Head-to-head: shipped pipeline vs standard vector-RAG baseline (cosine top-k, no lexical leg, no fusion)

fairness.sameQuestions: LLM-generated paraphrases, not written by the system's author
fairness.judgeIsDifferentFamily: yes — GPT judge, DeepSeek generator, so self-preference bias cannot favour either side

interpretation: contextPrecision +0.048: our ranking puts more relevant material in the window.
faithfulness -0.017: the baseline is very slightly more grounded, which follows from it
returning only cosine neighbours of the question; narrow context is easy to be faithful to.
latency 2875ms vs 35ms: ours runs the intent pipeline, query expansion and multi-pass
retrieval; the baseline is one cosine sort. That is the cost of the precision gain and
it is the number to watch if latency matters more than ranking quality.
